verdict.rationale: AngelList's conversions tooling generates an Excel-based pro forma with underlying formulas, explicitly intended for the legal team and prospective investors, so the SAFE-conversion and pro-forma sharing core is covered. Recording executed SAFE/note conversions and Excel report exports support the workflow. The update FAQ, however, describes helping customers move to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which raises doubt about the product's continued availability. Missing for 10: explicit priced-round dilution modeling, option pool top-up scenario modeling, in-platform scenario sharing beyond Excel export, clarity on product continuity, independent hands-on corroboration.
